title: Less Data, Better Timing: Student-Curriculum Coupling for VLM On-Policy Distillation in Temporal Video Grounding
abstract: arXiv:2609.40055v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides dense supervision directly on student-generated trajectories, making it an effective post-training strategy for vision-language models in temporal video grounding (TVG). However, existing pipelines typically construct the training curriculum from a fixed teacher and the initial student state, implicitly assuming that selected examples retain positive supervision value throughout optimization. We show that supervision trustworthiness and supervision necessity are distinct yet coupled: the former concerns target credibility, while the latter varies with the student's current task competence; together, they shape supervision value. Building on this coupled view, we introduce Student-Curriculum Coupling (SCC), a closed-loop framework in which a compact Anchor-Frontier curriculum defines the candidate supervision space and the evolving student dynamically determines its active subset. translated_title: 更少数据，更佳时机：面向时序视频定位中视觉语言模型在线策略蒸馏的学生-课程耦合
translated_abstract: 在线策略蒸馏（OPD）直接在学生模型生成的轨迹上提供密集监督，使其成为时序视频定位（TVG）中视觉语言模型的一种有效的后训练策略。然而，现有的流水线通常基于固定的教师模型和学生的初始状态来构建训练课程，隐含地假设所选样本在整个优化过程中始终保持正向的监督价值。我们证明了监督可信度与监督必要性是彼此不同却又相互耦合的两个概念：前者关注目标的可信程度，后者则随学生当前的任务能力而变化；二者共同决定了监督价值。基于这一耦合视角，我们提出了学生-课程耦合（SCC），这是一个闭环框架，其中紧凑的锚点-边界（Anchor-Frontier）课程定义了候选监督空间，而不断演进的学生模型则动态确定其活跃子集。监督可以……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出学生-课程耦合（SCC）闭环框架，通过让不断演进的学生模型动态地从紧凑的锚点-边界课程中选取活跃监督子集，实现了以更少数据、更优时机驱动的时序视频定位视觉语言模型在线策略蒸馏。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Student-Curriculum Coupling (SCC), a closed-loop framework in which the evolving student dynamically selects its active supervision subset from a compact Anchor-Frontier curriculum, enabling VLM on-policy distillation for temporal video grounding with less data and better timing.
